[[Black 3 (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996) added “Must have pilot aboard to use power or maneuver.” to the game text of unique unpiloted starships.<ref name="encyc-unlimited">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=35 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 35, Premiere Unlimited, “Revisions”: “the unique, unpiloted starships (such as Black 2, Black 3, Vader’s Custom TIE, Gold 1, Gold 5, Millennium Falcon, etc.) had the rule about requiring a pilot to use added directly into their game text.” Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).</ref> The Decipher.com card image ([[:File:Premiere-D-black3-decipher-archive.gif]]) has the black Limited border but prints that later sentence.
